study: Create a GAME ART DIRECTION TEST for Soulmonsters: TWO new ISOMETRIC OVERWORLD CHARACTERS standing together in a small piece of their actual starter-town environment. Input1 is ENVIRONMENT CAMERA/material reference ONLY: 2:1 orthographic isometric streets, cream raised sidewalks, warm ivory/blue modern houses, sparse greenery, crisp flat illustrated surfaces. Remove all old characters/HUD from this reference. Input2 is KAEL IDENTITY and delicate simple manga line reference, input3 PROFESSOR ASSIS IDENTITY. The task is to establish a NEW coherent overhead MANGA SPRITE style, not reproduce the old front-facing baby chibi sprites. CAMERA MUST BE STRICTLY ORTHOGRAPHIC ELEVATED ISOMETRIC, 2:1 ground axes slope +/-26.565degrees. View both bodies from ABOVE, showing significant TOP OF HAIR, TOP OF SHOULDERS, upper planes of shoes, foreshortened face, clothing hems and all foot contacts on SAME ground plane. Characters should feel built in the same projection as house/sidewalk, NOT eye-level portrait cutouts pasted onto floor. Compact semi-chibi anime bodies approximately3.25HEADS tall for Kael and3.5HEADS tall for adult professor, narrow readable limbs, restrained normal-size hands/shoes, heads modest not giant round baby heads. Professor stands about10percent taller, slightly broader adult face/shoulders, composed demeanor. Faces small clean oval anime eyes, tiny simple nose/mouth, thin subtle gray linework, large soft flat local color and ONE economical cel shadow. NO 3D, pixelart, rendered skin, shiny hair, gradient, thick sticker border, bobblehead or toy/plush style. Kael: dark navy high swept quiff, black tee, open blue jacket with ivory sleeve stripes/two connected short coat ribbons, turquoise headphones around NECK, gray slim trousers with left thigh band, dark ankle shoes. Professor: black swept hair with THREE ivory lateral tufts (his left side), brass/blue goggles on forehead, ivory rolled-sleeve labcoat, blue polo, brown trousers/shoes, tiny badge; no young alternate or bald bearded redesign. Composition LANDSCAPE single cohesive illustration: an uncluttered cream sidewalk corner next to a small front garden and partial house facade, enough blue asphalt at lower corner to establish scale. KAEL at center-left faces diagonally DOWN-RIGHT, PROFESSOR center-right faces diagonally DOWN-LEFT, each in clean3/4 overhead idle so we can see both faces and side depth, not pure front/profile. Both full bodies complete and separated, feet solidly placed on paving stones with small soft contact shadows directly beneath, same lighting fromupperleft. Two characters are the FOCAL POINT: each about27percent of canvas HEIGHT, camera close enough to inspect design but house remains appropriately larger, not giant humans. Minimize environment decoration to a low planter and one small potted plant; no crowd, creatures, vehicles, UI, speech bubbles, labels, panels, color chips, extra views, title or watermark. Floor joints follow exact same isometric axes as building and shoes. All vertical architecture lines remainvertical. Simple 2D manga environment with clean line/color like our approved house art, not heavily textured painting. This is one quiet in-world style proof, NOT a model sheet, NOT a promotional portrait shot.
